en.headline: 82-year-old woman dies after drowning at Clear Water Bay Second Beach
en.dek: Lifeguards rescued the swimmer about 5 metres offshore on Saturday morning; she was pronounced dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital.
body: An 82-year-old woman died after she was rescued from the water at Clear Water Bay Second Beach in Sai Kung on Saturday morning.

Police received a report at about 10am that a female swimmer was in difficulty about 5 metres offshore. Lifeguards brought her ashore unconscious. Ambulancemen took her to Tseung Kwan O Hospital, where she was certified dead at 11.17am.
The woman, surnamed Yeung, was understood to have a history of heart disease. Police contacted her family and classified the case as a drowning. The cause of death awaits autopsy results.

zh.headline: 清水灣二灘八旬女泳客遇溺不治
zh.dek: 周六早上救生員在離岸約5米處救起昏迷泳客，送將軍澳醫院後證實死亡。
body: 西貢清水灣二灘周六早上發生遇溺意外，一名82歲楊姓女泳客被救起後不治。
警方上午約10時接報，指泳灘對開約5米海面有女泳客遇溺。救生員將她救回岸上時已昏迷，救護員隨即以救護車送往將軍澳醫院搶救，延至上午11時17分證實死亡。
消息指事主疑有心臟病。警方已聯絡其家人，案件列有人遇溺處理，死因有待驗屍後確定。
